content:
Overview

Boulder is a city in CO with a population of 108,000. University town at the foothills of the Rockies with CU Boulder and a renowned food scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.8.
